Audit of the repo against CLAUDE.md turned up 9 rule violations. Here is what I found and what I plan to change.

**Found**
1. `plugins/diagrams/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: `"name": "diagram"` ≠ folder name `diagrams` (rule 2).
2. `plugins/avatar-video/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: no `description` (rule 2).
3. `plugins/outlook-email/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`: no `version` (rule 2).
4. `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`: no entry for the `diagrams` plugin (rule 2).
5. `plugins/x-assistant/skills/xhs-post/SKILL.md`: frontmatter has `name` but no `description` (rule 3).
6. `plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-scripter.md`: frontmatter has `description` but no `name` (rule 3).
7. `.claude/skills/quick-notes/SKILL.md`: a real skill created directly in `.claude/`, not in any plugin (rule 1). The other four dirs there are the third-party ones.
8. `.claude/agents/{x-drafter,video-reviewer,video-scripter}.md` look like real files, not symlinks into `plugins/`, and `x-reviewer` has no link at all (rule 1). Same question for the plugin skills, which have no `.claude/skills/<name>` links.
9. `README.md` has no row for `plugins/x-assistant/skills/youtube-post/` or `plugins/avatar-video/agents/video-reviewer.md` (rule 4).

**Changes**
- Fix items 1–6 in place (rename name to `diagrams`, add the missing `version`/`description`/frontmatter field, add the `diagrams` marketplace entry).
- quick-notes: move the skill to `plugins/quick-notes/skills/quick-notes/SKILL.md` with a new `plugins/quick-notes/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, add a marketplace entry and a README row, and turn `.claude/skills/quick-notes` into the symlink `../../plugins/quick-notes/skills/quick-notes`. (Tell me if you'd rather it live inside an existing plugin instead of getting its own.)
- Replace the duplicated files in `.claude/agents/` with symlinks to their `plugins/...` originals, add the missing `x-reviewer` link, and add `.claude/skills/<name>` symlinks for every plugin skill (never touching `heygen-avatar`, `heygen-video`, `hyperframes`, `media-use`).
- Add README rows for youtube-post, video-reviewer and quick-notes.
- Verify by re-reading every edited file, re-grepping the inventory (plugins vs `.claude` links vs README rows), and checking each `plugin.json`/`marketplace.json` parses. No test suite exists in this repo.

One caveat: my current toolset has no shell, so writing files may be possible but `ln -s` may not be. If I can't create symlinks, I'll still fix all the file contents and tell you exactly which `ln -s` commands are left for you to run rather than faking it with copies.
